title: Real Reference-Geometry Bilateral Separability Diagnostic
research_question: In the GigaHands reference geometry, is a sequence's LEFT normalised bone structure closer to its OWN RIGHT than to a RIGHT from a different sequence?

topology.verified: connected bones only; arbitrary joint pairs such as 4-8, 4-12 or 8-20 span no bone and are excluded

representation.step1: 20 connected bone lengths per frame per hand
representation.step2: p_b = l_b / sum_b l_b  (absolute hand size removed)
representation.template: bone-wise median of z over a unit's eligible frames

eligibility.frame_cap_rule: evenly spaced by frame index; deterministic and target-independent
eligibility.no_performance_based_filtering: frames are never removed for having a large left/right distance, an unusual bone, or any metric outcome

repeatability_split: SHA-256 parity of (sequence|camera|hand|frame); deterministic and independent of fit quality

identity.consequence: the primary contrast is stated as WITHIN_SEQUENCE vs CROSS_SEQUENCE, not same-subject vs cross-subject

cross_pairing.why: so that WITHIN and CROSS comparisons are not separated artificially by camera/view reconstruction differences
cross_pairing.aggregation: camera views are NEVER counted as independent participants; distances are aggregated to sequence-camera, then sequence level

C1_BONE_MAPPING_PERMUTATION.definition: right-hand bone indices permuted WITHIN each finger before the distance is taken
C1_BONE_MAPPING_PERMUTATION.why_within_finger: a global shuffle would also destroy the coarse size ordering of the bones, so its degradation could be explained without any anatomical correspondence

C2_SEQUENCE_LABEL_PERMUTATION.definition: right-hand sequence labels permuted across sequences, camera structure preserved
C2_SEQUENCE_LABEL_PERMUTATION.exact_if_small: with 5 sequences all 5! = 120 relabelings are enumerable, so the null is computed EXACTLY rather than sampled

underpowered_rule: if unique participants < 8, tag SUBJECT_SEPARABILITY_UNDERPOWERED, report descriptively, and do not conclude from a p-value alone
never_used: WiLoR or any learned hand latent
